title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Ending the Poverty Trap) Bill 2018
short_title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Ending the Poverty Trap) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase specified income support payments by $150 per fortnight for eligible recipients and change indexation arrangements for certain pensions and allowances.
A new supplement would cover eligible Newstart, Sickness and Widow Allowance recipients, while selected Youth Allowance and Austudy maximum rates would also rise.
The main changes would commence on 1 January 2019, but payments would require a parliamentary appropriation and the proposed ABSTUDY increase would need separate government action.
changes: Specified payments would use whichever is higher: consumer price indexation or pensioner and beneficiary living cost indexation.
Special Benefit and Crisis Payment maximums would reflect increases in the payments used to calculate them.
A contingent amendment would extend the supplement to Jobseeker Payment when the relevant welfare reform provisions commence.
summary.affected: Eligible allowance and student payment recipients, and pensioners covered by the changed indexation rules, are affected.
